job_expectations: Seeking a lead mobile role where I can shape native architecture across iOS and Android while mentoring a product-focused engineering team.
hobbies: Trail running, analog photography, and restoring vintage synthesizers.

experiences.description: Lead a cross-platform mobile team building consumer apps for iOS and Android. I set the architecture direction, own the release process, and review the toughest pull requests. I also coach engineers on performance profiling and crash triage.

Built and maintained the flagship native apps for a logistics-facing product. I drove a major refactor of the navigation layer and introduced a shared design-system component library. The changes cut the time to ship new feature screens noticeably.

Owned the iOS codebase for a media-streaming application with a large active user base. I led the migration to a modern concurrency model and improved cold-start time substantially. I mentored two junior developers through their first major releases.

Developed features across both iOS and Android for a social fitness app. I implemented the offline sync layer and integrated several third-party SDKs. My work on background sync reduced user-reported data loss.

Built native iOS features for an e-commerce client and maintained the checkout flow. I introduced automated UI smoke tests that caught regressions before release. The team adopted my testing pattern across other modules.

Contributed to a utility app while learning native development end to end. I fixed defects, implemented small UI components, and helped maintain the release checklist. This role started my path toward platform leadership.

projects.title: Tokenized Property Marketplace Coordination
projects.summary: Served as project manager for a platform pairing real-estate development listings with a tokenized investment layer. I coordinated cross-functional delivery across backend, mobile, and compliance, ran the planning cadence, and kept the roadmap honest against shifting regulatory input. The team shipped the pilot marketplace on schedule with clear stakeholder communication throughout.
